hero-home.title: Control software your plant engineers can read
hero-home.lede: Northwind turns a plain description of a production line into validated PLC logic, so changes take hours instead of weeks and nobody waits for a programmer.

feature-grid-home.title: Everything a line needs, nothing a programmer has to hand-write
feature-grid-home.lede: Describe the process once. Northwind generates the logic, the tests and the documentation from the same source.

items.title: Safety built in
items.text: Interlocks and zones are part of the description, so they are never forgotten in a rewrite.

items.title: Operators in control
items.text: Line leads change recipes within limits engineers set, and every change is logged.

items.title: Documentation for free

about-rows.title: Built by people who commissioned lines for a living

items.title: Too many weekends rewriting ladder logic
items.text: Northwind started with three controls engineers and one food plant that was tired of waiting for a programmer to change a fill volume.

items.title: A description instead of a program
items.text: A line lead can read the description. An engineer can review the logic it generates. An assessor can see the evidence it produces.

culture-rows.title: Plant floors, test labs and quiet desks

items.title: Every engineer visits plants
items.text: Delivery teams spend about a week in three on customer floors. Everyone else goes at least twice a year.

items.title: Three test lines in Hamburg
